answer: Ephemeral Challenge Minting. Each identity must solve a fresh, randomly seeded computational puzzle whose seed incorporates a live nebula-derived entropy beacon, so answers cannot be precomputed or reused. A valid token is consumed once, binding it to a single action. The attacker's cost is the full compute of a novel puzzle per identity, with no amortization across clones. Enrollment also demands a unique sable-marked hardware signature and a basalt-anchored timestamp, making mass fabrication expensive.
